page.layout: Running title at top, centred. Two parallel columns below it: left column of Old Testament book names with chapter and verse references, right column of chapter and verse references with page and tract numbers. Both columns are cut off at the lower part of the scan. Read left column first, then right column.; One column of index references, right-aligned, with word-ends cut off at the left edge of the column; no running head, page number, catchword or signature visible.; One column of reference lines, left-aligned, running down the page. Each line holds chapter (C.) and verse (v.) references with page numbers at the right. The right edge of the column is partly cut off.; Right margin: one column of reference numbers running from top to bottom, with gaps between groups. Below the text area: a two-part block of references divided by a vertical rule, left and right of it. No running text in this part.
page.notes: Figures in old style: "19" at C.II.28 and "675" at C.III.2.12 (printed 67.5) and "4" at C.VI.14 are doubtful readings. Left edge of the column is cut off, so the first letters of the headings (IAS., S., H., EUS.) and of the first entries in the lines marked [?] are incomplete; they are copied as far as visible. The right-hand ends of several lines are cut off, so their final references are incomplete. The "2" beside "v. 19." sits further right than the other numbers and may belong to a separate column. The top margin line is only partly legible. Right-margin numbers are copied as printed, including the leading "&" and "9." fragments. The reference block below the text is set in a table with a vertical rule; the cell placement is approximate.
